facts.text: I have a silver Honda Civic.
I washed my silver Honda Civic last Sunday.
The last oil change was done at 0 miles.
I bought the car when the last oil change was done, so it was essentially brand new.
I want to use conventional oil for my oil change.
I want to find a good mechanic or service center near me to do the oil change.
I plan to search online for mechanics in my area and check their reviews.
I want to ask about promotions or discounts for oil changes.
I have 4,500 miles on my car since the last oil change.
I want to get the oil change done as soon as possible.
I want to ask the mechanic about their experience with Honda vehicles and oil changes.
I want to ask for a breakdown of the costs involved for the oil change.
I want the price of the oil change included in the cost breakdown.
I want to know any additional services the mechanic recommends.
I want to know if there are any fees for disposal of the used oil and filter.
I want a clear idea of what I will be paying so I can plan accordingly.

keyphrases: disposal fees used oil and filter
